reason: B offers the more specific, physically grounded, and falsifiable mechanism: differential Mn versus Cr/Al transport producing a duplex scale, supported by reported Mn-rich outer and Cr-rich inner layers in Cantor-type alloys. Its experiment should control composition and phase constitution more tightly—preferably varying Mn systematically rather than adding an unspecified diffusion barrier—but it remains stronger than A’s overly general claim that any segregation is harmful and its questionable prediction that a thicker passivating layer indicates better resistance.
